notes.title: Some features will be available in game
notes.content:
Not the same as FPS, Taken Soul is third person game so it'll have advantages of these type of games such as:
[list]
[*] Running to escape from darkness force
[*] Shooting to kill all of threatens
[*] Driving duck's boat on HoXuanHuong's Lake
[*] Crouching through corspe in abandoned hospital
[*] And more than that....
[/list] 

[b]Add to your wishlist now and wait for new horror experiences[/b]
